title: Bigfoot rumours in D sector
place_text: D sector, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California

tellings.quote: to scare the new guys was Bigfoot's out there and he's he's going to get you, but there was nothing about UFOs or even talk about it that I know.

plain: In 1964, in D sector at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, guards scared the new men by telling them Bigfoot was out there and would get them, says a former nuclear missile guard named Richard Barth, who served there and says he was later abducted by aliens. Barth adds that there was no talk of UFOs at all that he knew of, which matters because it means nothing had primed him for what he says came later.
